ordering: Relational results are unordered unless SORT, PICK, DEDUPLICATE, SAMPLE or WINDOW explicitly orders them.
resource_policy: Server-set row, retained Arrow byte, input-byte, DuckDB memory and wall-clock limits. No disk spill, external access, extension autoload or unbounded source prefetch.

forms: none: approval and governed action backend required
limits: no implicit writes or tool payloads
negative_cases: all ACT plans rejected before source execution

forms: group_by with SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT
limits: AVG is floating-point; SUM preserves DuckDB decimal semantics

forms: none: governed model backend required
negative_cases: all ASK plans rejected before source execution

forms: date_trunc day, week, month, quarter, year into a new column
limits: no parsing, timezones or calendar plugins

forms: one row per partition_by, explicit sort
limits: JSON row value breaks ties deterministically

forms: named typed arithmetic, comparison, boolean, coalesce expressions
limits: division is floating-point; division by zero returns null
exact decimal literals must be strings, precision <=38

forms: whole-row or explicit column distinct
distinct set subtraction
limits: exact same ordered Arrow schema; EXCEPT ALL not supported

forms: one Arrow list column into a new element column
limits: null/empty lists produce zero rows; null elements are retained

forms: typed predicates with SQL three-valued null semantics
limits: source pushdown only matching-type comparisons, AND/OR/NOT/IS_NULL

forms: replace nulls in one column using a typed non-null literal
distinct set intersection
limits: exact same ordered Arrow schema; INTERSECT ALL not supported

forms: inner, left, right, full equality join on explicit keys
limits: inputs must have disjoint column names; rename with PROJECT

forms: first N per partition_by with explicit sort
limits: default N=1; JSON row value breaks ties

forms: fixed values using SUM conditional aggregates
limits: no dynamic columns or alternative pivot aggregates

forms: explicit columns and named typed expressions
observed date/time buckets followed by explicit aggregates
limits: no synthesized empty intervals or gap filling

forms: fixed-size sample without replacement ordered by seeded MD5 of row JSON
limits: deterministic for fixed typed rows; duplicates remain separate rows

forms: none: governed retrieval/index backend required
negative_cases: all SEARCH plans rejected before source execution

forms: column projection and typed expressions locally; projection only at source
limits: no arbitrary SQL or connection payload

forms: multi-key ASC/DESC, explicit null placement
limits: equal sort keys have unspecified relative order; add a unique key

forms: same typed aggregates as AGGREGATE
append two inputs including duplicates
union with whole-row deduplication
limits: exact same ordered Arrow schema; nulls compare as set members

forms: explicit columns to name/value pairs, retaining nulls
row_number, rank, dense_rank; SUM/MIN/MAX/COUNT over ROWS preceding to current row
limits: no RANGE, following frames, LAG/LEAD or dynamic expressions
